title: Gourmet Caramel Apples
description: This gourmet caramel apple recipe dips apples in melted milk chocolate and drizzled with colored candy melts, making them festive for any time or season.
ingredients: 1 (14 ounce) package individually wrapped caramels, unwrapped
7 ounces chocolate candy bar, broken into pieces

steps.text: Bring a large pot of water to a boil; add apples briefly, using a slotted spoon, to remove any wax that may be present. Wipe dry; cool. Insert sticks into apples through cores.

Place unwrapped caramels and 2 tablespoons water into a microwave-safe medium bowl. Microwave on high for 2 minutes; stir. Continue microwaving and stirring, at 1 minute intervals, until caramel is melted and smooth.
Line a baking sheet with waxed paper; coat with cooking spray. Hold apples by sticks; dip into caramel to coat. Set on waxed paper; refrigerate to set, about 15 minutes.
Microwave chocolate and 1 tablespoon shortening in a microwave-safe bowl until melted and smooth. Dip apples into chocolate to cover caramel layer; return to waxed paper to set.

Place candy melts and remaining 1 tablespoon shortening in a micro-wave safe bowl; microwave until smooth, stirring every 30 seconds. Drizzle melted candy melt in a colorful design onto coated apples using a fork or wooden stick. Refrigerate until set, overnight is better.
